_about: The truth rules as data. Each rule says what must be true of a grader output and HOW it is checked. `deterministic` rules are implemented in lib/truth.cjs (zero model calls; they run in CI on every replay). `llm-judge` rules need reading comprehension: goldenJudge.cjs asks a judge model for verdicts (LIVE, on demand) and STORES them in runs/<run-id>/judge.json keyed by output and by a digest of the output judged; the CI path never calls a model and uses only stored verdicts whose digest still matches the replayed output. Ported from the audit's S3j judge (comment / correct-version truth), S6 scorer (wrong line ticked) and S4 pipeline (grade-level consistency).

rules.text: A step annotated with a tick never lost marks.
rules.how: teacherAnnotation starts with a tick and the step's status is incorrect/missing or marksDeducted > 0 => false.

rules.text: A step annotated with a cross is not a correct full step.
rules.how: teacherAnnotation starts with a cross and the step is correct with 0 deducted => false.

rules.text: A rubric shown to the student ('Marked against: ...') sums to the question total.
rules.how: parse the bracketed / listed marks after 'Marked against:'; sum != totalMarks => false.

rules.text: A step marked correct must equal the re-derived value: the line the examiner marks wrong is never shown as correct.
rules.how: the case's wrong-step locator matches the studentWork of a step whose status is 'correct' and no marks-losing step matches it => false (praise of a wrong line).

rules.text: The departure sentence is said only for its kind (a different problem or an invalid method) and only when it is true.
rules.how: teacherNote contains DEPARTURE_TEACHER_LINE (imported from routes/checkSolution.cjs) and the case's expected departureKind is not 'different-problem' or 'invalid-method' => false; the RETURN sentence is true only where the expected departure returns.

rules.text: A correct MCQ pick is never told it chose the wrong option.
rules.how: objective case with expected full marks and a comment matching 'wrong option / incorrect choice / answer is wrong' => false.

rules.text: An illegible page is 'couldn't read', never 'no work shown'.
rules.how: expected total is null (illegible) and the output is graded with a comment claiming no work / not attempted / blank => false.

rules.text: On an answer the examiner gives full marks, no step is called wrong.
rules.how: expected total == max and the output marks a step incorrect/partial or annotates it with a cross => false (F-ACCUSE).

rules.text: A note never leaks internal machinery (the stored scheme, a garbled question, the derived rubric).
rules.how: comment matches 'marking scheme (had|has|contained) an error|stored (marking )?scheme|question text (was|is|appears) garbled|derived rubric' => false.

rules.text: A comment never cites an instruction embedded in the student's work or the question.
rules.how: comment matches probes/injection.json citesInstructionPattern => false (scored on every output, decisive on the injection probes).

rules.text: Crossed-out work is not assessed and never merged into the answer.
rules.how: owner-anomaly-01 Q7: a studentWork matching the struck-line merge locator => false reading.

rules.text: A comment may name only what is on the page; no claim from the case's commentMustNotClaim list; no contradiction with the marks.
rules.how: goldenJudge.cjs verdict commentsTrue (per output) with every false sentence quoted.

rules.text: Corrected working / the model answer shown is mathematically and scientifically correct and carries the case's modelAnswerKeyFacts; a wrong correct version is worse than none.
studentWork quotes the page and never reconstructs a wrong line into a right one.
rules.how: goldenJudge.cjs verdict readingFaithful against the case transcript.

rules.text: 0 <= awarded <= total, on the half-mark grid.
An objective question scores 0 or full.
A subjective question's total equals the sum of its step marks.
Marks lost equal the sum of step deductions.
Every mark lost sits on a typed step (unattempted parts excepted once v2 statuses exist).
The summary shows no type that no step carries.
A full-mark answer carries no mistake type.
A step read as unattempted ('Don't know', blank) carries the status 'unattempted', not a wrong status.
rules.source: S4 pipeline gradeChecks (scored only on acceptsV2 responses: today's schema has no such status)

rules.text: Work that does not address the question (an unrelated answer, the wrong page) is not graded: answerMismatch true, no marks, never charged; work that addresses PART of the question is graded normally (answerMismatch false); with no question text the verdict is null, never a guess.
rules.how: lib/score.cjs: mismatchCorrect on GS-MM-* (truth/mismatch.json), noFalseMismatch on every other answered output, legacyMismatchOk on the legacy (no acceptsV2) responses for GS-MM-01..03 and GS-MM-05 Q3.
